memories.content: Cameron is Prime Minister and has publicly stated he will campaign for the UK to remain in the EU. He has not yet confirmed any specific televised set-piece events about the referendum, but he is aware of the upcoming referendum and the need to communicate his position.

The UK EU referendum is scheduled for 23 June 2016. Televised set-piece events (such as debates or major interviews) about the referendum may be organized by broadcasters. The Prime Minister's participation in such events is at his discretion and subject to scheduling.
